items.title: Mail list
items.detail: Mail an agent already read, in a running turn or with es mail check, no longer counts as unread or shows a struck bolt; the unread count matches es mail. When there is nothing to re-offer, Wake now is hidden. Kind labels share one column, so titles line up.

items.title: Faster with a busy Core
items.detail: The Front Desk and the activity list make fewer reads at a time, so chats and the sidebar stay responsive while Core is slow.

items.title: Wake state on mail
items.detail: Unread mail shows a bolt instead of words: struck through and grey when no wake is scheduled, plain with a countdown when one is. Hover it for the full text.

items.title: Spend in the title bar
items.detail: The title bar shows Today, WTD and MTD spend in UTC across every Work host: OpenRouter billing plus gateway and other providers. If a host is off, ≥ marks the amount as partial and the tooltip names the host.

limits: Agent photos are not shown yet; rows show initials.
